name: Populate the existential-risk register
text_content:
Type: founder decision

Source: Session 3 of the Scaling People translation program, page section 6.4 of the S3 page in the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253. Session task 86ajgmhgx.

Her rule that leadership must "invest in critical work that no one else will naturally step up to prioritize" survives intact. The record names candidate risks without listing them: the chef dependency; undercapitalization and weak controls; food safety; key-person loss; customer acceptance of compensation built into price; sound; the stack breaking; and, added by the team, the founders' own bandwidth across floor, build, and content engine. The founders decide which risks are on the register, in what order, and which founder owns each. The register is the source of "what keeps you up at night" at the house review.
